description: eugr's (Eugene Rakhmatulin) spark-vllm-docker glm-5.3-flash recipe for local-inference-lab's GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4-Spark (ModelOpt mixed NVFP4 checkpoint of Z.ai GLM-5.3-Flash, MIT; checkpoint revision a6082410) served by vLLM on two Sparks. Runs eugr's published vllm-node-b12x image (nightly-20260929, `--exp-b12x` lane, digest pinned; its build-metadata records spark-vllm-docker 42f62e34 and the local-inference-lab/vllm dev/karmic-kraken vLLM fork with lukealonso's b12x kernels) with upstream's launch: modelopt_mixed quantization, B12X attention, MoE and linear backends, b12x load format, FP8 KV cache with block size 256, hybrid mamba cache mode align, chunked prefill and prefix caching, MTP speculative decoding with five tokens (humming drafter MoE backend, B12X attention), glm45 reasoning and glm47 tool-call parsers, 500,000-token context, four sequences, 4,096 batched tokens and memory utilisation 0.87 (upstream defaults), with the upstream RoCE all-reduce and ahead-of-time compilation environment. Upstream's kv_cache_memory_bytes default (8G) is not used by its launch command and is not applied. The recipe is cluster-only upstream (two Sparks). No upstream performance claims are recorded. Upstream repository MIT. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. Memory follows the creator's settings: gpu-memory-utilization 0.87 with no explicit KV pool, as in eugr's recipes/glm-5.3-flash.yaml at 303b4a29 (line 30); the yaml declares kv_cache_memory_bytes 8G (line 29) but its launch command never passes it (lines 50-76). The steady per-node peak is 0.87 x 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus 10.4 GB for CUDA context, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers (a speculative draft is profiled inside the utilization budget); the reserve is 8 GB, and admission keeps the platform memory floor free beside the peak.
title: GLM 5.3 Flash NVFP4 Spark B12X MTP vLLM two Sparks (eugr)
